title: `positions/replies-to-rivals` registers the grade of the Map's reply to illusionism (P-RR1) and the beautiful-loop theory (P-RR2), but not to Griffin's panexperientialist interactionism. `concepts/nondualistic-interactionism` L41 calls that view "the closest non-dualist rival the Map has" and concludes "The view is not refuted here"
